title: Anthropogenic Forcing, Climate Change, and the Shape of Warming: Statistical Inference for Distributional Cointegration
abstract: arXiv:2609.16509v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Anthropogenic forcing components follow different long-run paths, while persistent temperature change can involve distributional changes beyond the mean. Scalar regressions aggregate these components and retain only mean temperature, obscuring how distinct forcing paths relate to persistent distributional change. We develop new testing, estimation, and inference methods for long-run relations between an integrated predictor vector and a density-valued response. These comprise a residual-based test of between-cointegration (whether predictor trends account for all stochastic trends in the response density), a fully modified least-squares estimator of predictor-specific functional responses, and simulation-based inference for interpretable projections. translated_title: 人为强迫、气候变化与变暖的形态：分布协整的统计推断
translated_abstract: 人为强迫的各分量遵循不同的长期路径，而持续性的温度变化可能涉及超出均值的分布形态变化。传统的标量回归将这些分量汇总，且仅保留平均温度，从而掩盖了不同强迫路径与持续性分布变化之间的关联。我们针对积分（单整）预测变量向量与密度值响应之间的长期关系，开发了新的检验、估计和推断方法。这些方法包括：基于残差的“间协整”检验（用于判断预测变量的趋势是否能解释响应密度中的所有随机趋势）、针对各预测变量特定函数响应的完全修正最小二乘估计量，以及用于可解释投影的基于模拟的推断方法。我们将这些方法应用于观测得到的局地温度异常密度，以及划分为二氧化碳（CO₂）与非二氧化碳组合的人为有效辐射强迫。检验结果表明……
tldr: 本文针对积分预测变量与密度值响应之间的长期关系提出了新的统计检验、估计与推断方法（包括间协整检验、完全修正最小二乘估计量和基于模拟的推断），并将其应用于分析CO₂与非CO₂人为强迫对局地温度异常分布持续性变化的影响。
en_tdlr: This paper develops new testing, estimation, and inference methods for long-run relations between integrated predictor vectors and density-valued responses—including a between-cointegration test, a fully modified least-squares estimator, and simulation-based inference—and applies them to analyze how CO₂ and non-CO₂ anthropogenic forcing relate to persistent distributional changes in observed local temperature anomalies.
